newsitem.title: ITALY: Gemina shares to be suspended Friday.
newsitem.headline: Gemina shares to be suspended Friday.

text.p: Shares in Italy's Gemina are to be suspended on Friday pending the announcement of 1996 results, a spokesman for stock market watchdog Consob said on Thursday.
The spokesman also said the hiving off from Gemina of HPI -- Holding di Partecipazioni Industriali -- had been completed with the registration of the new company on a court register.
HPI, which is to be listed on the Milan bourse on Monday, is a holding company controlling industrial interests formerly owned by Gemina.
Gemina shares closed 1.67 percent higher at 1,007 lire.
Gemina shareholders will on Monday receive one HPI share for each Gemina share held.
